html.title: KOBOOL has great news for: $V{lname}
html.body:
Dear $V{lname}

KOBOOL is pleased to inform you that the Electronic Matching Operation that was done on $V{date} found that you and $V{mate} have Primary Mutual Acceptance.
That is because each of you added the other to his/her Acceptance List.

A similar message has been sent to $V{mate} containing the same news.

To start contacting with $V{mate}, login to your KOBOOL account and a communication page will be opened to send and recieve messages.

Both you and $V{mate} will be excluded from the next Electornic Matching unless one of you declines from proceeding with marriage relationship via the "Decline" form that is currently available for both of you to use if things didn't work out between you two.

Important Note: KOBOOL notification message might not reach $V{mate} for any reason.
Also, $V{mate} might be out of town or away from his computer for sometime.
That could cause your match to not respond to your messages for a while.

Hence, we advice you to have patience and not to rush the progress of your relationship with $V{mate}.

We would like to mention again that the Matching Operation does not match couples unless both of them have previously accepted each others, and it takes in consideration the rankings and Acceptance dates for the matched couples,
so that the outcome would be fair for all members.

At the end, have our best wishes.

KOBOOL.com team.
